answer: Price admission in copper, and make it convex. The first wallet costs a modest stake; each additional one costs double, so a sybil fleet of a thousand clones costs more copper than the economy's honest turnover. During a seasoning window a young account votes with only a feather of weight, its signature checked against the writing quill registered at its birth, so clones cannot pool influence or forge history. A proven misdeed burns the whole stake and strips the feather plume down to nothing. One honest identity then beats a warehouse of rented ones on cost alone.
